2609.08566.title: BIO-MEMART: Biometric-Aware KV Cache Memory for Multi-User LLM Agents
2609.08566.paper_summary: KV cache is evolving from a serving optimization into an external memory substrate for long-term LLM agents. In a shared multi-user deployment, however, reusable KV blocks introduce a missing access-control question: semantic relevance alone cannot determine whether a memory block is authorized for the current physical user. We propose Bio-MemArt, a biometric-aware KV-cache memory framework for multi-user LLM agents. Bio-MemArt attaches a normalized biometric template to each stored KV memory block, filters the shared memory pool with the current user's biometric probe, and then runs the original MemArt retrieval and KV reuse pipeline only inside the authorized candidate pool. This design preserves latent-space retrieval, direct cache reuse, and decoupled position encoding while adding physical-user access control to shared KV memory. We evaluate Bio-MemArt under Owner and Non-owner query conditions on long-term dialogue QA with face and palmprint benchmarks. Across face benchmarks, the average owner and non-owner biometric success rates are 95.71% and 0.86%; across palmprint benchmarks, they are 97.60% and 2.00%. In the efficiency study, average prefill tokens drop from 18,781.96 under full-context prompting to 28.57 with Bio-MemArt, showing that biometric gating preserves the low-token operating regime of KV-cache memory.
2609.08566.paper_summary_zh: KV 快取正從服務優化演變為長期 LLM 代理的外部記憶基底。<lb/>然而，在共享的多用戶部署中，可重用的 KV 區塊引入了一個缺失的訪問控制問題：僅僅依賴語義相關性無法判斷一個記憶區塊是否被當前的實體用戶授權。<lb/>我們提出了 Bio-MemArt，一個考慮生物識別的多用戶 LLM 代理的 KV 快取記憶框架。<lb/>Bio-MemArt 將一個標準化的生物識別模板附加到每個存儲的 KV 記憶區塊，使用當前用戶的生物識別探針過濾共享記憶池，然後僅在授權候選池內運行原始的 MemArt 檢索和 KV 重用管道。<lb/>這個設計保留了潛在空間檢索、直接快取重用和解耦位置編碼，同時為共享的 KV 記憶添加了實體用戶的訪問控制。<lb/>我們在面部和掌紋基準下，對長期對話 QA 在擁有者和非擁有者查詢條件下評估了 Bio-MemArt。<lb/>在面部基準中，平均擁有者和非擁有者的生物識別成功率分別為 95.71% 和 0.86%；在掌紋基準中，則為 97.60% 和 2.00%。<lb/>在效率研究中，平均預填令牌數從完整上下文提示下的 18,781.96 降至使用 Bio-MemArt 的 28.57，顯示生物識別閘控保留了 KV 快取記憶的低令牌操作範疇。
